natural_language_statement: The polynomial shift sends each variable X i to X i + C (c i), and shiftCoefficient c β a is the β-coefficient of the shifted monomial with exponent a. The bundle gives the coefficient formula as a product of binomial coefficients and powers of c, expands shifted monomials, and defines the finite row-choice and row-scalar data used to express coefficients after adding power-series tails.
explanation: These declarations make coefficient extraction under coordinate translations explicit. The product expansion reduces the shift of a monomial to finitely many coordinate choices; the rowScalar definition records the corresponding binomial, translation, and power-series coefficient factors for downstream row expansions. The bundle also supplies the multi-index conversion and the truncation tail used by the source’s row calculations.
